implementation.full_R1_R6_source_rule: selected unit must expose every unique overall slot 1-72; later duplicate player selections do not remove source membership but the later duplicate occurrence is excluded and counted against retention
implementation.historical_contamination_rule: screen the selected unit slots 1-72; any explicit devy custom player or uniquely resolved NFL draft class different from target year rejects the whole league; diagnostic unknowns do not reject
implementation.historical_search_order: for each 2018-2023 year, cap each frozen search term to 100 unique league IDs by SHA256(year|term|league_id), union all capped IDs with every V6 clean seed league, then probe the complete union ordered by SHA256(year|candidate|league_id); no early stopping
implementation.holdout_2024_contamination: reuse the pre-outcome V6 clean classification; do not reselect, replace, or post-hoc contamination-filter the ten frozen leagues; only rebuild slots 1-72 and pre-outcome identity metadata
implementation.holdout_2024_reuse: select exactly the ten already-frozen V6 clean leagues whose frozen selected-unit summary contains at least 72 picks; perform no 2024 leagueSearch and no replacement/substitution
implementation.identity_assets: download/freeze one shared pre-search identity asset bundle in prepare; all year workers and 2024 worker use byte-identical assets
identity_priority: existing FantasyPros-to-Sleeper crosswalk with unique nflverse draft-class corroboration
implementation.missing_keeper_proxy: keeperType missing is accepted as the frozen V6 validated historical proxy; explicit keeper/redraft/non-dynasty is rejected
implementation.search_transport_failure: fatal red workflow condition; never reinterpret a failed request as an empty result
implementation.selected_draft_unit: accept a single draft unit or the unique LEAGUE-type draft unit; reject ambiguous multi-unit leagues
implementation.sleeper_ready_reason: Sleeper historical weekly NFL stats is the frozen Phase 3 provider, so outcome-ready Sleeper mapping is an operational identity-readiness prerequisite, not an FV result
implementation.weighting: within each year and R1-R6 cell, each represented frozen league receives equal total weight and valid occurrences divide that league-cell weight; each development year targets 1/6 total macro weight
